entities.summary: Marina Anatolyevna Pankova née Nikulina was a Russian volleyball player who was a member of the Soviet team that won the gold medal at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul. Four years later, she won a silver medal with the Unified Team at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona. She was a setter.
